# authwise_tenant_home_administration (Resource)

Turns on the tenant's home administration (kit#916): its administrators sign in at one of its issuers, and that issuer's host serves the administration console at `/admin/`. kit creates the administration audience, its catalog and the console's client, and records them on the tenant (`authwise_tenant_config.administration` reads them too).

Enabling is idempotent. **There is no disable here:** destroying the resource only removes it from state, and the entry stays enabled. An operator's `DisableProduct("administration")` on the tenancy admin service is the only way off.

Enabling needs `tenancy.administration.enable` at the tenant, which only `tenancy.owner` holds: a service account with `tenant.admin` is refused. Run it with the tenant owner's credentials.

The issuer needs a binding at the root of a host (`authwise_issuer_domain_binding` with no `path`): home administration exists only on a host that names one tenant at its root.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The tenant's administrators sign in at its issuer on login.acme.com, and
# https://login.acme.com/admin/ serves the administration console. Run with
# the tenant owner's credentials: only tenancy.owner may enable it.
resource "authwise_domain" "login" {
  custom   = true
  hostname = "login.acme.com"
}

resource "authwise_issuer" "home" {}

# Home administration needs a binding at the root of a host.
resource "authwise_issuer_domain_binding" "home" {
  issuer_id = authwise_issuer.home.issuer_id
  domain_id = authwise_domain.login.domain_id
}

resource "authwise_tenant_home_administration" "this" {
  issuer_id = authwise_issuer.home.issuer_id

  depends_on = [authwise_issuer_domain_binding.home]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `issuer_id` (String) The tenant's issuer (`i-…`) its administrators sign in at, `authwise_issuer.<name>.issuer_id`. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `tenant_id` (String) The tenant; overrides the provider default. Changing it enables the new tenant and leaves the old one enabled.

### Read-Only

- `audience_id` (String) The administration audience (`a-…`) kit created on the issuer.
- `console_client_id` (String) The console's public client (`c-…`) on the issuer.
- `name` (String) The tenant's name, `tenants/{t}`; serves as the Terraform ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The tenant, by name or id.
terraform import authwise_tenant_home_administration.this tenants/t-01
```
